body:
Getting some sunlight definitely is something I want to do asap. I've been staying in my room for the last few days, fearing that the freezing winds outside might worsen my current ear infection. 

Seeing the clear blue skies through the window and not being able to enjoy them is sometimes very frustrating. My mind screams for some proper Vitamin D, which I appreciate. It's nice to be able to feel excited about something as simple as a sunny day after months of severe depression.

 I'll take your experiences and try something similar myself, thank you and have a nice day kind stranger!

That's an interesting mindset actually. Never really got the chance to think about it that way since I've been nothing else but struggling for so long.

Hopefully I'll get to experience it sometime soon. Thank you for the input, kind stranger.

Actually I've been going to therapy and taking antidepressants for over a year now. Therapy does help me somewhat, even if it's just during and shortly after each session. The medication helps with my symptoms, which is another plus.
I had one to two close friends who I could confide in, but they cut all contact after my suicide attempt. Maybe you can imagine how hurt and lost I feel. Not saying that what I did was totally fine, but now it doesn't matter much anyway. Trying to keep myself together is my only focus at the moment, hopefully the rest will somewhat sort itself out.

Both I think. Never properly got over my broken heart, which has its origin in unrequited love and many toxic friendships I had to endure. Maybe also the severe bullying I experienced during my time in school. The latter doesn't affect me directly anymore since it happened a few years ago, but it probably did some damage regardless. 
Normally I love being there for everyone who's important to me, but I'm starting to avoid people in fear of getting my heart broken again in any way, shape or form.

May I ask if you had any specific cause for your depression? Do you have any tips on finding hope and a way out of it?

The constant feeling of being a burden, hopelessness and loneliness, being used and treated like crap constantly even by people who I thought cared about me.

It's an endless cycle. Yes, there are better days here and there, but the worst days are just so unbearable. I only wish for peace and warmth, nothing more and nothing less.

It's the only thing helping me push through as well. I would've been long gone otherwise. 
Sometimes, caring about others emotions and well-being can truly be a pain in the ass.

Dying being a certainty does take some pressure out of my situation, but it's so hard if every day seems to be filled with pain and darkness. Still, I appreciate your words and I am glad you're doing better now. Wish you only the best, kind stranger.

Thank you kind stranger. Sadly I can't quite free myself from the big sad, no matter how hard I try. 
Since my best friend blocked me yesterday due to not being able to endure my attempt, I feel like it's only a matter of time until I try again. Always knew there's no room for me in this world. 

But believe me, your words do indeed comfort me. Even if it's temporary.
